funFacts: Kevin Yu became the third player from Chinese Taipei to win on the PGA Tour, joining T.C. Chen and C.T. Pan.
Yu birdied the par-4 18th hole twice in the span of 30 minutes, first to force a playoff and then to win it.
Beau Hossler suffered his second career playoff heartbreak on the PGA Tour despite carding four rounds in the 60s.

headline: Sanderson Farms: Kevin Yu birdies 18th in playoff to defeat Beau Hossler for maiden PGA Tour title
whyCareReason: Kevin Yu delivers clutch birdies on the 72nd hole and first playoff hole to capture his first career PGA Tour victory in dramatic style at Jackson.
teaser: Sunday at Country Club of Jackson: Kevin Yu shoots a final-round 67 to tie Beau Hossler at 23-under, then drains a five-foot birdie putt on the 18th in sudden death.
story:
Why this one matters: The FedExCup Fall season produced unforgettable drama in Mississippi as 26-year-old Kevin Yu secured his maiden PGA Tour championship with back-to-back clutch birdies on the 18th hole at the Country Club of Jackson.

Trailing Beau Hossler by one shot standing on the 72nd tee, Yu stuck his approach to six feet and calmly poured in the birdie putt for a 5-under 67, matching Hossler (68) at 23-under 265. 54-hole leader Keith Mitchell had a 35-foot birdie attempt on the final green to join the playoff, but watched his effort roll inches by the cup to finish tied for third with Lucas Glover at 22-under.

Returning to the 18th tee for the sudden-death playoff, Yu striped a 310-yard drive down the center fairway and hit a gorgeous 110-yard wedge to within five feet. When Hossler failed to convert his 20-footer, Yu stepped up and rolled in the winning putt, unleashing a celebratory fist pump and earning a two-year PGA Tour exemption along with invitations to the Masters and PGA Championship.
stakes: Maiden PGA Tour title, 500 FedExCup Fall points, $1.44 million winner's check, and a two-year exemption through 2028.
rivalryAngle: Yu outduels Hossler in sudden death after both players matched each other shot-for-shot over 72 regulation holes.
